# FundAdmin AI

> Supervised-pilot release candidate: 62 fund administration workflows plus the fund menu for Claude Code, Cowork and Codex. Review documents, prepare drafts and evidence-linked calculations for human review. Python 3.9+ is required for report helpers; external checks depend on authorised tools and evidence. Not certified for production operations or automated investment, admission, clearance, filing or payment decisions. Human review required; external operational qualification not tested. Host/model and optional connector data flows apply. Not financial, legal or tax advice.

Python 3.9+ is required for standard-library helpers; PDF dependencies are pinned in requirements-plugin.txt.
Primary runtime qualification: installed Claude Code 2.1.278, explicit model trace and all 14 saved cases for the candidate; consult the verification record. Codex and Cowork support the package format but their runtimes are experimental/unverified; Codex evidence is direct inline only, Cowork unverified.
Marketplace installation refers to the published 1.0.2 baseline; use the reviewed local-checkout route for the unpublished candidate. Private host evidence belongs outside plugin build inputs.
Direct and routed skills use shared report contract v1 and reviews/<fund>/<date>/<run-id>/<subfolder>/<report-id>/<filename>; evidence sidecars retain source/output hashes.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, how it works, every command
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents installing, using or changing the plugin
- [catalog.json](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/catalog.json): machine-readable index of skills and agents
- [Samples](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/samples/README.md): synthetic documents with planted issues

- [Pilot limits](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/docs/production/README.md): supervised-pilot release candidate, not certified production
- [Runtime policy](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund/references/production-policy.md): every direct/routed skill
- [Report contract](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund/references/report-contract.md): v1 evidence, hashes and isolated runs
- [Privacy](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills#privacy): host/model and connector data flows

## Skills

- [fund](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund/SKILL.md): Main menu and router for the 62 FundAdmin AI skills: fund document review, notice drafting, compliance, negotiation, tracking, analytics, intake and reporting. For bare `/fund` or `/fundadmin:fund` with no subcommand: you MUST ALWAYS invoke this skill via the Skill tool (input matching fund) BEFORE answering, then emit the full 62-command menu including review-lpa, review-capital-call, draft-capital-call, report-pdf. Answering that menu without a Skill tool call is incorrect — do not reconstruct it from memory or catalog alone. Also use when the user asks what the assistant can do, lists commands, or asks for a fund admin task without naming a skill. Route `/fund <cmd>` and `/fundadmin:fund <cmd>` (including wire-verify) to the matching fund-<cmd> skill via the Skill tool.
- [fund-review-lpa](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-lpa/SKILL.md): Reviews LPA provisions using methodology v2 heuristic document favourability, separate coverage confidence and source-linked findings. Writes LPA-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-ppm](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-ppm/SKILL.md): Scores a PPM or offering memorandum on risk factor completeness, fee disclosure clarity, regulatory status (Reg D, 3(c)(1)/3(c)(7), ERISA) and LPA consistency. Use when the user runs `/fund review-ppm`, asks to review offering documents, or shares a PPM. Writes `PPM-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-subscription](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-subscription/SKILL.md): Verifies investor qualification, FATCA/CRS forms, AML and ERISA representations and signatures in a subscription agreement, then scores it. Use when the user runs `/fund review-subscription`, asks to check subscription documents, or shares one. Writes `SUBSCRIPTION-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-side-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-side-letter/SKILL.md): Builds an obligation inventory from a side letter, categorizes every right, rates MFN cascade risk, and flags LPA and cross-side-letter conflicts. Use when the user runs `/fund review-side-letter`, asks about MFN exposure, or shares a side letter. Writes `SIDE-LETTER-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-capital-call](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-capital-call/SKILL.md): Validates an incoming capital call notice: pro-rata math, fee line items, wire instructions, due dates, and LPA consistency, then scores it 1-10. Use when the user runs `/fund review-capital-call`, asks to verify a capital call, or shares a call notice. Writes CAPITAL-CALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-distribution-notice](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-distribution-notice/SKILL.md): Validates a distribution notice to 8 decimals: imputation credits, RWT, and return-of-capital versus income classification. Use when the user runs `/fund review-distribution-notice`, asks to check a distribution, or shares a distribution notice. Writes DISTRIBUTION-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-capital-account](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-capital-account/SKILL.md): Validates a capital account statement to the dollar: extracts every field, checks ending capital arithmetic, reconciles tranches. Use when the user runs `/fund review-capital-account`, asks to verify a statement, or shares a capital account statement. Writes CAPITAL-ACCOUNT-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-k1](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-k1/SKILL.md): Extracts every box of a Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) including Section L, validates capital account arithmetic, flags UBTI and ECI exposure, and scores completeness. Use when the user runs `/fund review-k1`, asks to check a K-1, or shares a K-1 tax package. Writes `K1-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-poa](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-poa/SKILL.md): Reviews a Power of Attorney used in fund transactions: extracts grantor, attorneys and authority clauses, rates breadth of discretion, and flags cross-border enforceability gaps. Use when the user runs `/fund review-poa`, asks to check a POA or mandate, or shares one. Writes `POA-REVIEW-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-gp-update](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-gp-update/SKILL.md): Analyzes a GP activity update: FPAUM bridge, deployment pace, realisations, fundraising momentum, and gross MOIC against plan, scored 1-10. Use when the user runs `/fund review-gp-update`, asks how a GP is executing, or shares a GP activity update. Writes GP-UPDATE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-compare](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-compare/SKILL.md): Compares two fund documents and rates each difference material, significant, administrative, or cosmetic, flagging who it favors, GP or LPs. Use when the user runs `/fund compare`, asks what changed between versions, or shares two LPAs or side letters. Writes FUND-COMPARISON-[name]-[date].md.
- [fund-extract-terms](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-extract-terms/SKILL.md): Extracts all defined terms, fee provisions, key dates, governance and reporting obligations from a fund document, with plain English summaries and section references. Use when the user runs `/fund extract-terms` or asks to extract a document's terms. Writes TERMS-EXTRACT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-capital-call](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-capital-call/SKILL.md): Drafts a structured capital call notice with purpose breakdown, per-LP pro-rata table, recallable designation, default consequences, and wire instructions. Use when the user runs `/fund draft-capital-call` or asks to issue a capital call. Writes CAPITAL-CALL-[fund]-[number]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-distribution](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-distribution/SKILL.md): Drafts a distribution notice with waterfall tier math, per-LP split by return of capital, preferred return and profit, tax withholding, and clawback reserve. Use when the user runs `/fund draft-distribution` or asks to issue a distribution. Writes DISTRIBUTION-NOTICE-[fund]-[number]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-investor-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-investor-letter/SKILL.md): Drafts LP communications: quarterly update, annual meeting notice, onboarding welcome, closing announcement, investment period extension, or wind-down notice. Use when the user runs `/fund draft-investor-letter <type>` or asks to write to LPs. Writes INVESTOR-LETTER-[fund]-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-side-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-side-letter/SKILL.md): Drafts an LP side letter from requested provisions (fee discount, MFN, co-invest, reporting, ERISA) with LPA section references and MFN cascade risk. Use when the user runs `/fund draft-side-letter` or asks to draft a side letter for an LP. Writes SIDE-LETTER-[investor]-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-check-compliance](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-check-compliance/SKILL.md): Audits a document against FATCA, CRS, AML/KYC, ERISA, Form PF, Form D, Form ADV, AIFMD, SFDR, and SEC Marketing Rule checks, scoring each framework. Use when the user runs `/fund check-compliance`, asks for a compliance gap check, or shares an LPA or PPM. Writes COMPLIANCE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-kyc-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-kyc-review/SKILL.md): Scores one investor's KYC and AML package out of 100 across identity, beneficial ownership, sanctions and PEP screening and source of funds, and assigns a risk classification. Use when the user runs `/fund kyc-review` or shares a KYC package. Writes KYC-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-regulatory-filing](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-regulatory-filing/SKILL.md): Prepares filing drafts and evidence gaps; no submission or compliance certification. Writes FILING-PREP-[type]-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-audit-support](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-audit-support/SKILL.md): Builds an audit package from capital account data: draft auditor confirmation letter, partner capital, and management fee schedules. Use when the user runs `/fund audit-support`, asks to prepare for the annual audit, or shares capital account data. Writes AUDIT-SUPPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-waterfall-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-waterfall-review/SKILL.md): Extracts waterfall tiers, preferred return, catch-up, carry, clawback and fee terms, checks consistency, and scores each against market standard. Use when the user runs `/fund waterfall-review`, asks about fund economics, or shares waterfall provisions. Writes `WATERFALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-report-pdf](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-report-pdf/SKILL.md): Renders fund review Markdown or structured JSON into a branded PDF, preserving report content, score labels and scales, evidence and limitations. Use when the user runs `/fund report-pdf` or asks for a PDF of a review. Writes FUND-REVIEW-REPORT.pdf.
- [fund-lpa-negotiate](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-lpa-negotiate/SKILL.md): Turns LP-unfavorable LPA provisions into counter-proposal language, ranked P0 to P4 with likelihood of GP acceptance, a four-round roadmap and concession matrix. Use when the user runs `/fund lpa-negotiate` or asks for LPA negotiation strategy. Writes NEGOTIATION-STRATEGY-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-benchmark](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-benchmark/SKILL.md): Scores economic and governance terms against this skill's reference ranges, classing each LP-Friendly, Market Standard, or GP-Favorable with a 0-100 score. Use when the user runs `/fund benchmark`, asks if terms are at market, or shares an LPA. Writes BENCHMARK-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-plain-english](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-plain-english/SKILL.md): Translates a fund document clause by clause into plain English: practical impact, risk flags, a defined-terms glossary, and worked waterfall and clawback examples. Use when the user runs `/fund plain-english`, asks what a clause means, or shares an LPA or PPM. Writes PLAIN-ENGLISH-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-playbook](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-playbook/SKILL.md): Tracks how a firm's LPA terms drift across fund vintages and builds a negotiation playbook of standard positions and red lines. Use when the user runs `/fund playbook`, asks how terms changed between Fund II and Fund III, or shares LPAs from several vintages. Writes TERMS-PLAYBOOK-[date].md.
- [fund-search-precedent](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-search-precedent/SKILL.md): Searches prior review outputs for provisions matching a query, ranks matches by fund, vintage and section, and compares corpus positions versus outliers. Use when the user runs `/fund search-precedent` or asks how a clause was handled on past funds. Writes PRECEDENT-SEARCH-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-counsel-handoff](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-counsel-handoff/SKILL.md): Packages an LPA, PPM or side letter review into a brief for external counsel: P0-P3 triage, redline requests and open questions with section citations. Use when the user runs `/fund counsel-handoff`, asks to brief outside counsel, or shares a review file. Writes COUNSEL-HANDOFF-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-mfn-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-mfn-tracker/SKILL.md): Tracks MFN provisions across a fund's executed side letters, builds an eligibility matrix per LP, flags cascade risk, and drafts election forms and a redacted disclosure schedule. Use when the user runs `/fund mfn-tracker` or shares several side letters. Writes MFN-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-obligation-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-obligation-tracker/SKILL.md): Inventories every side letter obligation by category, frequency, due date, and compliance status, with an exam-ready activity log. Use when the user runs `/fund obligation-tracker`, asks which deadlines are outstanding, or shares side letters. Writes OBLIGATION-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-covenant-monitor](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-covenant-monitor/SKILL.md): Extracts financial, reporting, and negative covenants from a credit facility and reports compliance status and headroom. Use when the user runs `/fund covenant-monitor`, asks about covenant breach risk, or shares a subscription line or loan agreement. Writes COVENANT-MONITOR-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-regulatory-calendar](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-regulatory-calendar/SKILL.md): Builds a 12-month filing calendar from fund type, registration, and AUM, spanning Form ADV, Form PF, Form D, FATCA/CRS, and AIFMD Annex IV, with 90/60/30-day alerts. Use when the user runs `/fund regulatory-calendar` or asks what filings are due. Writes REGULATORY-CALENDAR-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-performance-calc](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-performance-calc/SKILL.md): Computes IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, MOIC, and PME from cash flows or a capital account statement, with helper bisection workpapers and J-curve analysis. Use when the user runs `/fund performance-calc`, asks what a fund returned, or shares cash flow data. Writes PERFORMANCE-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-cashflow-forecast](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-cashflow-forecast/SKILL.md): Projects capital calls, distributions, and NAV from explicit dated assumptions using deterministic Decimal workpapers, with scenario comparisons. Use when the user runs `/fund cashflow-forecast` or asks to forecast calls or LP liquidity. Writes CASHFLOW-FORECAST-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-scenario-model](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-scenario-model/SKILL.md): Models fund outcomes under Downside, Base Case and Upside assumptions: IRR, TVPI, DPI, carried interest, LP net returns and waterfall tier reached, plus sensitivity and breakeven. Use when the user runs `/fund scenario-model` or asks to stress-test returns. Writes `SCENARIO-MODEL-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-fee-audit](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-fee-audit/SKILL.md): Audits management fee basis, offsets and expense caps, plus preferred return, catch-up, carry and clawback, against LPA terms and the ILPA Fee Reporting Template. Use when the user runs `/fund fee-audit`, asks if fees are correct, or shares fee workpapers. Writes FEE-AUDIT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-investor-onboard](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-investor-onboard/SKILL.md): Prepares an investor onboarding checklist and evidence-gap draft for human review. Writes ONBOARDING-CHECKLIST-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-ddq-respond](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ddq-respond/SKILL.md): Drafts answers to an investor DDQ or RFP mapped to ILPA sections, citing sources, grading them A-F, and flagging the questions that need human input. Use when the user runs `/fund ddq-respond`, asks to answer a DDQ, or shares a due diligence questionnaire. Writes DDQ-RESPONSE-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-entity-map](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-entity-map/SKILL.md): Maps a fund structure into a Mermaid diagram, entity registry, ownership chain and fee-flow tables, flagging blocker, feeder and ERISA plan-asset gaps. Use when the user runs `/fund entity-map`, asks to diagram a structure, or shares formation documents. Writes ENTITY-MAP-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-data-room](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-data-room/SKILL.md): Generates an ILPA-aligned virtual data room index across eight categories with Required/Recommended/Optional status, gap priorities, and access tiers by investor type. Use when the user runs `/fund data-room <type>` or asks how to organize a fundraising data room. Writes DATA-ROOM-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-portfolio-dashboard](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-portfolio-dashboard/SKILL.md): Aggregates several funds' documents into one LP view: TVPI/DPI/RVPI, strategy and GP mix, J-curve stage, and unfunded commitments. Use when the user runs `/fund portfolio-dashboard`, asks how the book is doing, or shares capital accounts across funds. Writes PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD-[date].md.
- [fund-reconcile](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-reconcile/SKILL.md): Matches two fund documents line by line: capital call vs capital account, distribution vs K-1 Box 19, or sequential statements, then scores the result. Use when the user runs `/fund reconcile`, asks why balances do not tie, or shares two documents. Writes RECONCILIATION-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-deed](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-deed/SKILL.md): Reviews a deed of adherence, equity wrapper, or management participation agreement: obligations assumed, vesting, good and bad leaver terms, and information access limits. Use when the user runs `/fund review-deed`, asks to check leaver terms, or shares a deed. Writes DEED-REVIEW-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-investor-classify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-investor-classify/SKILL.md): Classifies an investor into a regulatory category, builds the document requirements checklist, and maps FATCA, CRS, ERISA, UBTI and ECI exposure. Use when the user runs `/fund investor-classify` or asks to classify an investor. Writes INVESTOR-CLASSIFICATION-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-fatca-crs-classify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-fatca-crs-classify/SKILL.md): Determines an investor's FATCA Chapter 3 and 4 status, FFI or NFFE type, CRS classification, required tax forms and controlling person disclosure. Use when the user runs `/fund fatca-crs-classify` or shares a W-8 or CRS self-certification. Writes FATCA-CRS-CLASSIFICATION-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-suitability-check](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-suitability-check/SKILL.md): Verifies Accredited Investor, Qualified Purchaser and Qualified Client status from subscription documents, flagging borderline and specific-purpose cases. Use when the user runs `/fund suitability-check` or asks whether an investor qualifies. Writes `SUITABILITY-CHECK-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-aml-screen](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-aml-screen/SKILL.md): Reviews supplied screening evidence and records checks not performed; no sanctions clearance or admission decision. Writes AML-SCREENING-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-kyc-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-kyc-tracker/SKILL.md): Tracks KYC collection across every investor in a fund: per-investor completeness, outstanding document matrix, expiry alerts and refresh cycles by risk rating. Use when the user runs `/fund kyc-tracker` or asks where fund-wide KYC stands. Writes KYC-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-subscription-process](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-subscription-process/SKILL.md): Reviews classification, documents, suitability, FATCA/CRS, screening evidence and subscription gaps for human review. Writes SUBSCRIPTION-PROCESS-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-ingest](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ingest/SKILL.md): Classifies a folder of mixed fund PDFs, routes each to its `/fund review-*` skill, auto-reconciles matching pairs and runs the portfolio dashboard at 3+ funds. Use when the user runs `/fund ingest` or drops a folder of GP portal PDFs. Writes INGEST-REPORT-[date].md and INGEST-MANIFEST.md.
- [fund-ingest-email](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ingest-email/SKILL.md): Parses an email or .eml and its attachments, then cross-validates the amounts, deadlines and fund names it claims against the documents to flag mismatches and wire fraud. Use when the user runs `/fund ingest-email` or pastes a GP email with attachments. Writes EMAIL-INGEST-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-vault-init](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-vault-init/SKILL.md): Creates an Obsidian vault for fund administration: review subfolders, Dataview dashboards, Fund and Investor templates, and an Inbox ready for `/fund ingest`. Use when the user runs `/fund vault-init` or asks to set up a fund vault or knowledge base.
- [fund-vault-sync](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-vault-sync/SKILL.md): Copies approved new reviews into the Obsidian vault with YAML frontmatter, tags and backlinks; proposes additions to existing Fund and Investor notes without overwriting them. Use when the user runs `/fund vault-sync` or asks to sync reviews into the vault. Writes `VAULT-SYNC-[date].md`.
- [fund-monitor-email](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-monitor-email/SKILL.md): Reads an explicitly authorised Gmail scope for fund emails, stages PDF attachments in an isolated review run and logs provenance. Use when the user runs `/fund monitor-email` or asks to check for new GP documents. Writes EMAIL-MONITOR-[date].md.
- [fund-multi-doc-analyze](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-multi-doc-analyze/SKILL.md): Cross-references 2+ related fund documents for provision conflicts, amendment lineage, and MFN cascades. Use when the user runs `/fund multi-doc-analyze`, asks how an LPA, side letters, and amendments interact, or shares several fund documents together. Writes MULTI-DOC-ANALYSIS-[date].md.
- [fund-smart-contract-sim](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-smart-contract-sim/SKILL.md): Simulates a distribution waterfall as programmable logic: tier-by-tier execution traces, edge cases, clawback validation and pseudocode. Use when the user runs `/fund smart-contract-sim`, asks how a waterfall would execute, or shares LPA waterfall terms. Writes `WATERFALL-SIM-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-chat](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-chat/SKILL.md): Conversational query interface over fund documents and prior `/fund` outputs, answering with document, section, and exact-quote citations and routing to the command that fills a data gap. Use when the user runs `/fund chat` or asks ad hoc questions about their fund documents. Answers inline.
- [fund-amendment-draft](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-amendment-draft/SKILL.md): Drafts a formatted LPA amendment with recitals, amendment clauses, ratification, signature blocks, and a redline of old versus new text. Use when the user runs `/fund amendment-draft`, asks to amend an LPA, or shares an LPA with the changes wanted. Writes AMENDMENT-DRAFT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-esg-report](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-esg-report/SKILL.md): Builds a preliminary ESG report for applicable SFDR, climate, EDCI, PRI and Taxonomy frameworks using verified versions, supplied data and explicit gaps. Use when the user runs `/fund esg-report`, asks for an SFDR or PAI disclosure, or shares portfolio ESG data. Writes ESG-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-tax-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-tax-review/SKILL.md): Analyzes a K-1 or tax package for UBTI, ECI, Section 199A QBI, 163(j) limits, state apportionment, PFIC exposure and capital account reconciliation. Use when the user runs `/fund tax-review` or asks what a K-1 means for UBTI, ECI, withholding or state filing. Writes `TAX-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-board-memo](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-board-memo/SKILL.md): Prepares a board, LPAC, annual, or special meeting memo with agenda, performance and portfolio sections, conflict disclosures, resolutions, and Q&A prep. Use when the user runs `/fund board-memo <type>` or asks to prepare LPAC or annual meeting materials. Writes BOARD-MEMO-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-wire-verify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-wire-verify/SKILL.md): Flags bank/beneficiary changes and missing callback evidence for wire instructions; issues a masked verification checklist. Use for `/fund wire-verify`, `/fundadmin:fund wire-verify`, new bank details, payment-instruction checks, or a shareable wire report that must mask account/tax/passport IDs. Writes WIRE-VERIFY-[fund]-[date].md.

## Agents

- [fund-terms](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-terms.md): Terms & Provisions, 25% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)
- [fund-risks](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-risks.md): Risk Assessment, 31.25% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)
- [fund-compliance](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-compliance.md): Regulatory Compliance, 25% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)
- [fund-obligations](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-obligations.md): Obligations & Timeline, 18.75% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)
- [fund-recommendations](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-recommendations.md): Recommendations (excluded), 0% of v2 heuristic document favourability (not a safety verdict)

Terms runs first; risk/compliance/obligations depend on terms and may run in parallel; recommendations run last and are excluded. Unknown dimensions make the aggregate unavailable. Coverage confidence is separate.
